Theo: Morning! Day 1 for me. Quick: who owns the owner-of-owners list for infra tasks (routing rules, model fallback, Dedicated GPU access)? Trying to avoid pinging the wrong folks.

Rina: Hey Theo 44b. Short map: eng-platform = routing policy config; eng-runtime = model fallback logic; infra-access (me/Cam) = Dedicated GPU invites & quotas.

Theo: If I need a fast quota bump for a spike in staging, what's the fastest path?

Cam: Open an infra-requests ticket with pool name + expected qps, then DM @Cam with the ticket link. We can grant a temporary burst (1-4h) while we assess capacity. Use template: https://boards.redwood.com/infra/requests and tag "dedicated-gpu".

Theo: Good. And if I change alert thresholds for a service I own, who reviews the PR?

Rina: Add eng-sre and eng-runtime as reviewers. Minor tweaks = PR + brief rationale. Major changes = please schedule a 15-min sync so SRE can validate noise impact.

Theo: Who to page for runtime latency?

infra-bot: Page order: @eng-runtime-oncall, then @eng-sre if infra implicated. Customer-impacting incidents also page @product-oncall. Playbook: https://playbooks.redwood.com/runtime-p99

Theo: Awesome, thanks! I'll file the request now and tag Cam.

Cam: Welcome aboard 44b - ping if you want me to approve quickly.
